# Compose native popup target staging through Participation

## Context and problem

After #18396, default popup hover feedback renders. Native popup-to-popup transfer still fails on merged `d9ea7a5b44`: the existing headed `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` journey claims Metrics, renders its preview and successfully parks the source, then never transfers or closes that source. The native ownership record remains bound. This is a separate accepted residual from #18383, not more work on that merged PR.

The test observes the root consumer's still-live `lastCrossWindowTransfer` receipt. Its failed values correctly report the baseline failure. Default popup commits use the shared WorkspaceSet directly, so the replacement receipt reads authoritative Group source/target documents while retaining physical closure, native-owner and pane-identity observations.

## Architectural reality and fix

`DragTarget.onRemoteDragMove` requires `stageDragEmbodiment(payload) === true` for an embodied native drag, and its settlement path requires an explicit acknowledgement. `PopupWorkspace.syncParticipation` supplies neither. Workstation's root builds four wrappers around the existing `vesselProxyEmbodiment` owner, while the full popup supplies none.

Compose those existing stage/restore/promote/settlement operations in `Participation`, with explicit handler configs retaining precedence and the supplied controller/proxy retaining lifecycle ownership. Workstation passes those owners and deletes its four wrapper bodies; PopupWorkspace passes the same existing proxy owner. Preserve the exact physical source window across target-local reparenting in `VesselEmbodiment`. Adapt Emmy's existing `3a640d6d` change to current dev; do not replay its older PreviewContract or overlay source.

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Participation target hooks | Existing DragTarget stage/settlement contract | Delegate through supplied embodiment and affordance owners; await pane and renderer | Missing/refused owner fails closed | Config/method JSDoc | Real-object controls and native transfer |
| Proxy physical origin | Existing VesselEmbodiment transient record | Explicit source wins; otherwise retain active origin or resolve live pane origin before staging | Invalid identity refuses | move JSDoc | Parked-source and repeated-frame control |
| Workstation native receipt | Group snapshot + NativeLifecycle | Assert source/target document ownership, source closure and same live pane | Refusal preserves source ownership | Existing E2E intent | Headed on-screen movement, no synthetic page pointer |

Decision Record impact: aligned-with ADR 0029's shared drag/embodiment owners; no wire, history, or native-authority redesign. Structural pre-flight: existing files only; Agent OS structure map N/A.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Participation composes supplied embodiment and affordance owners for stage, restore, promote and renderer settlement; explicit callbacks still override defaults and borrowed owners are not destroyed.
- [ ] AC-2: settlement waits for both the exact pane and preview; missing, refused or retired state cannot release the target handoff.
- [ ] AC-3: a parked pane's physical source window survives target-local reparenting and repeated frames; exact-source restore returns it to that source.
- [ ] AC-4: Workstation deletes the four repeated target callback bodies and full popups use the same existing owner; no second proxy registry or app-specific engine import.
- [ ] AC-5: the existing native popup-to-popup journey reaches target preview, source park, Group document transfer, source retirement and same live pane in the target. The sibling native-titlebar-to-main journey remains passing. State the CDP movement evidence boundary explicitly.

- [ ] AC-6 (operator-requested): add a permanent resize-before-hover journey. Enlarge the target popup substantially, compare preview/menu geometry to the new DOM bounds, then transfer another popup into the newly exposed area beyond its former right edge.

## Out of scope

Resizing an already-hovered target (the reproduced warm-cache defect is tracked separately by #18400), independent full roots, native geometry/claim-arbiter redesign, the separate human pointer-overlap journey, Feed virtual-row identity census, module-wide class conversion, new undo/persistence logic, Brain/tooling changes, and reopening #18383 or #18396.

## Avoided traps and prior art

Keep the native trigger: observed real window movement, not injected geometry or page mouse events. Memory Core records `646a21dc-f546-4e17-b8cc-4ef32e26b24e` and `36bf5655-6ef7-4d2c-aedc-b0739636df1b` explain why off-screen/emulated-screen setups and intermediate main-window claims misdiagnose this journey. #18121 owns older placement/claim instability; this leaf addresses the newly omitted target composition.

Live latest-20 open issues, own assignments and latest-30 all-status A2A checked immediately before creation; no equivalent leaf/claim found. Emmy's latest handoff reports no active writes or native fixtures. No ask/KB tool used under current operator scope.
